payload.text: The kovacs baseline rerun with python3-venv. Condition: kovacs-sysadm reports python3-venv installed on kovacs (hv has been asked to approve it; vc relays). Then: at main's head, prep.sh <label> --sha HEAD and kv-prep.sh <label>, a START to gtools-vc as a kovacs leg (it loads this Mac through kovacs's two vCPUs), kv-window.sh <label> --cargo lua-build shellcheck prez-build lua-plan relink loop; pdf2md's not ok 5 to 15 and xtrct's 6 and 7 should go, and every remaining failure is named in watch-out 4. Then todo 5 at the last landing's head before hv's push. kovacs's two checked download dirs stay in its /tmp until a restart clears them: /tmp/dc-2141-sc090.i5YjL5 and /tmp/dc-2141-lua.61GdRV (refetch with tmp/dc-2141/sc090/kovacs-fetch.sh and kovacs-lua-fetch.sh, then fix the two paths in kv-remote.sh).
